meta.name: network-vpn-security
meta.description: Use for VPC/VNet/subnet design, VPN, routing, DNS, firewall rules, ACLs, security groups, private endpoints, bastions, hybrid or multi-cloud connectivity, zero trust access, Kubernetes network policies, MTU, latency, and secure network troubleshooting.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划云网络并排查连通与安全问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要设计云网络或排查连通故障。
copy.tagline_en: Design secure cloud networks and fix connectivity issues.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design VPCs or debug connectivity issues.

howto.what: 技能启用后,当涉及网络、VPN、安全连接等话题时,Claude 会先读取内置工作流文档,按流程分析流量路径、信任边界,给出拓扑、安全模型、实现与验证步骤,并列出风险与回滚方案。
howto.when: 当用户提出 VPC/子网设计、VPN、路由或防火墙等网络相关需求,或要求排查安全网络连接问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个VPC子网划分方案,生产环境与开发环境隔离。
say.note: Claude会按流程给出拓扑、安全边界与配置步骤。

say.text: VPN隧道延迟高还经常断,请从流量路径排查MTU和路由。
say.note: Claude会先读工作流,再定位DNS、NAT与隧道状态。

say.text: 为K8s集群设置NetworkPolicy,默认拒绝所有东西向流量。
say.note: Claude会给出策略实现与验证方法。

howto.what_en: When enabled, for network/VPN/security topics Claude reads the built-in workflow first, analyzes traffic paths and trust boundaries, then outputs topology, security model, implementation/validation steps, risks and rollback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about VPC/subnet design, VPN, routing or firewall rules, or requests secure network troubleshooting.

say_en.text: Design a VPC subnet plan with production and development environments isolated.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the workflow to give topology, boundaries, and steps.

say_en.text: VPN tunnel has high latency and drops; troubleshoot MTU and routing from the traffic path.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow, then checks DNS, NAT, and tunnel status.

say_en.text: Set up Kubernetes NetworkPolicy to deny all east-west traffic by default.
say_en.note: Claude will provide policy implementation and validation.
